title: Add F168 methods and validation results
Record three submissions and 77.46M integrated coverage result
Amy/temporal validation 2026 10 30
body:
## Three-submission update (October 30, 2026)

Tested three pipe-replacement plans focused on reducing construction costs while maintaining required iron-pipe coverage and budget constraints.

### Public results
- **Center and split:** $77.11M
- **Integrated coverage:** $77.46M — best result
- **Corrected 21a comparison:** $74.95M

The integrated-coverage approach improved the first valid submission by about **$344K**, mainly through more efficient circle geometry and coverage handling.

Ryota's earlier $77.29M result is kept only as a historical reference because our audit found missing required geometric coverage.

A separate temporal-validation update evaluates the robustness and generalization of these results.

title: Replace current model selection with fixed-specification CMS002 and HFX001
body:
The previous recommendation was selected through repeated historical candidate comparisons. Switch the current model pointers to **CMS002** (conditional repair cost) and **HFX001** (2027 annual leak probability), following the requested fixed-specification policy. CMS001/F168 artifacts and their original provenance remain historical.

Both new models use four underlying predictors (material, surface, length, year-start age) plus two missing-input flags. The specification and code were committed as `6a2da48` before fitting and pushed before this run computed report-year metrics. There is one fixed shallow CatBoost configuration, with no feature/model/threshold/weight search, early stopping, public-score adjustment or metric-based fallback.

Publish both fitted models, all four prespecified descriptive backtest years, row-level predictions, 2027 inventory forecasts, input/source/protocol hashes and reproducibility checks. Update the cost-model registry and both current-model pointers. This is a modeling-policy update; no official-evaluator submission or new work-order optimization was performed.

**Limitations:** previously inspected 2023–2026 years are not an untouched holdout. The new specification cannot erase knowledge from earlier experiments, and no accuracy improvement is claimed. The fixed hazard model materially underpredicts 2026 leaks (about 1,082 predicted versus 3,038 observed); settings were not revised after viewing this result. The 2024–2026 mean conditional-cost RMSE is $115,040.41. Incomplete inputs remain flagged; long-horizon and private-score performance are unverified.

Validation: four temporal/data-integrity tests pass; saved/reloaded models and reversed input rows give exactly identical predictions; all saved and staged Git artifact hashes match the manifest; the current-model selector resolves CMS002. Final release commit: `26213fa`.

See `notebooks/ensemble_for_cost_prediction/fixed_protocol/README.md` and `RELEASE.md` for the specification, reproduction and all results.
